title: Soviet postcard of the Karelia tourist complex, Petrozavodsk
alt: A tall brick-red hotel tower with rows of balconies behind a long low building, a lake on the horizon and a tour bus parked at right.

postmark.basis: Hand cancel partly legible; 415 03 is a Teplice postcode

date.basis: Print run line on the back reads 11.04.84; cancel dated 19.10.26

catalog.label: Subject
catalog.value: Petrozavodsk, tourist complex "Karelia" (Петрозаводск. Туристический комплекс «Карелия»), as captioned on the back

catalog.label: Stamps
catalog.value: Czech Republic: N (domestic tariff) stamp of Alfons Mucha's "Podzim" (Autumn), 1896, 2025 issue. Blue PRIORITAIRE label

catalog.label: Publisher
catalog.value: Sovetskaya Rossiya (Советская Россия), A05816, 11.04.84, IZO-620, print run 50,000, order no. 1085, RPP-3

tpa_note: A 1984 Soviet card, mailed from the Czech Republic 42 years later.
